==Purpose of template==
Given a delimited string of ancestors, produce an ancestry string.

==How to use==
 <pre>{{Ancestry|ancestors_string|subject|custom header}}</pre>

==Examples==
 <pre>{{Ancestry|grandfather;father;myself|myself}}</pre>

{{Ancestry|grandfather;father;myself|myself}}

 <pre>{{Ancestry|grandfather;father;myself||3=== My Ancestry ==
<nowiki />}}</pre>

{{Ancestry|grandfather;father;myself||3=== My Ancestry ==
<nowiki />}}

 <pre>{{Ancestry|grandfather;father;myself||blah}}</pre>

{{Ancestry|grandfather;father;myself||blah}}

 <pre>{{Ancestry|unknown;Abell Cauthon;Mat Cauthon|Mat Cauthon}}</pre>

{{Ancestry|unknown;Abell Cauthon;Mat Cauthon|Mat Cauthon}}

 <pre>{{Ancestry|unknown;[[Abell Cauthon|Abell]];[[Mat Cauthon|Mat]]|[[Mat Cauthon]]}}</pre>

{{Ancestry|unknown;[[Abell Cauthon|Abell]];[[Mat Cauthon|Mat]]|[[Mat Cauthon]]}}
